grid.layout_notes: Official rowsReels 1-3-5-5-3-1. Locked Enhancer Cells above/below each reel; Cake Buster unlocks positions. Locked reels expand as unlocked.

win_system.notes: Scatter Wins: 7+ matching symbols anywhere pay; winners remove and drop.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning symbols removed; new symbols drop in.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Cake Buster / Bonus unlock locked reel positions and Enhancer Cells.

other.name: Multiplier Blocks
other.how_it_works: Per-position mult applies to symbol win; doubles on win / Cell Search / xSplit; cap 128× base, 512× Manhunt.

other.name: Cell Search
other.how_it_works: On no win: collect lowest object symbols into a Wild with mult per collected; doubles mults on collected positions.

other.name: Enhancer Cells
other.how_it_works: Top/bottom locked cells per reel; when unlocked reveal Prisoner or feature (not Bonus).

wilds.name: Wild (Cake Buster / Cell Search)
wilds.behavior: From Cake Buster unlock or Cell Search conversion.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: Reels 2–5. Any Bonus unlocks Enhancer Cells on its reel. 3 → Sewer Escape; 4 → Manhunt. During bonus 2/3/4 Bonus → +2/+3/+4 spins.

multipliers.name: Multiplier Blocks
multipliers.behavior: Double on win/Cell Search/xSplit up to 128× base / 512× Manhunt; sticky in bonus.

specials.name: Cake Buster
specials.behavior: Unlock locked position → Wild; if none locked, random position → Wild.

specials.name: xWays
specials.behavior: → Prisoner revealing 2–4 same; multiple Ways sync symbol.

specials.name: xSplit
specials.behavior: Doubles all Multiplier Blocks on its reel; converts to Prisoner.

specials.name: Yard Dealer
specials.behavior: Upgrades a random object to higher pay; converts to Prisoner.

base_game_loop.summary: Pay-anywhere 7+ on 1-3-5-5-3-1 with tumbles. Per-cell Multiplier Blocks (double to 128×). Features: Cake Buster, xWays, xSplit, Yard Dealer, Cell Search on dead spins. Bonus unlocks enhancers; 3 Bonus → Sewer Escape (setup spins, sticky 2/4/8/16× on locked); 4 → Manhunt (512× cap + corner enhancers). Boosters 2×/20×/100×/2,000×.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional Bonus Booster 2×, 2× Bonus 20×, 2× Bonus + Open x64 100×, or 2× Bonus + All x128 2,000×.

phases.name: Cascade loop
phases.what_happens: Evaluate 7+; remove; drop; apply xWays/xSplit/Yard Dealer/Cake Buster; Cell Search if no win.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Pay-anywhere after cascades; position mults apply; Cell Search on dead board.

modes.name: Sewer Escape Spins
modes.spins_awarded: Set in Bonus Setup Mode; each +1 symbol adds one spin. Extra: 2/3/4 Bonus during feature → +2/+3/+4.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Unlocked enhancers carry from base; unlocked positions stay; Mult Blocks persist (cap 128×). Locked reels get sticky 2×/4×/8×/16×.
modes.progressive_state: Multiplier Blocks do not reset between spins.

phases.name: Bonus Setup
phases.what_happens: Set spin count via +1 symbols; assign sticky mults on locked reels.

modes.effects: Setup-determined FS; sticky mults; 128× mult cap.

modes.name: Manhunt Spins
modes.spins_awarded: Same setup rules as Sewer Escape.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Sewer features plus Mult Blocks cap 512×; corner Enhancer Cells unlock when their corner reels fully unlocked.

phases.name: Enter Manhunt
phases.what_happens: Sewer rules with 512× cap and corner enhancers.

modes.effects: Sewer Escape+; 512× mult cap; corner enhancers.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Exact default Bonus Setup spin count not printed on CMS.

features.name: Cell Search
features.effects: Collect lowest objects into Wild; double their mults.

ante_bet.notes: Boosters used instead of classic xBet.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Scatter Wins 7+; Mult Blocks; Sewer Escape / Manhunt; boosters 2/20/100/2000×; max 46532×.

unknowns: exact default spin count from Bonus Setup Mode before +1 symbols
